profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at AWS
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer that loves to dive deep on problems. I'm curious about every nook and cranny of creating, operating, maintaining, and innovating on software.

In my free time, I find myself playing team sports, particularly ball hockey and soccer. The interpersonal element is amazing, and the opportunity to grow not only as an individual but as a team is satisfying. You can find me in the National Ball Hockey League this season playing for the Crystal City Hedgehogs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At AWS, I've found my passion in diving deep into the operational side of engineering, making services that just work.

I joined a new team, becoming the median tenure member in only a few months. I've experienced organizational pivots and managed the uncertainty that comes with it, proving that I'm ready for any challenges that rears its head.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At BlueVoyant, I was on a core team to the overall product, working with web-scale data to identify ownership of internet assets.

I've done a lot of work to further the product, but I'm most proud of my work on stability and performance in our footprinting pipeline. I took outages and failures from daily occurrences to be ignored to rare events that deserve investigation.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Docker · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Elasticsearch · Vue.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the AdWords conversion tracking team, I focused on the conversion stats databases, ensuring there was clean and logical dataflow from the event stream to the user-consumed indices.

My work was primarily in Java and C++, as well as a proprietary SQL-like language. I learned a lot in my tenure at Google, but needed the freedom of a smaller company to really grow and gather valuable experience as an engineer.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · C++ · SQL · Protocol Buffers

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description: In the intern program at Data Works, we created a data monitoring system with the capability to detect anomalies in the running of various ETL jobs and notify administrators of serious issues in their systems.

positions.title: Tutoring Lab Staff
positions.description: While working in the tutoring lab, I helped students in all the 1000 and 2000 level math classes at Virginia Tech.  While demanding, it helped me stay sharp and maintain my own mathematics skills while developing them in others.

honors.title: Successful Participant - Mathematical Contest in Modeling
honors.description: In a team of 3, we built a model to predict the growth of languages in different regions of the world, and predict the ideal locations a theoretical business would want to start a bilingual office.  The competition took place over the course of 4 days in early February, and for our efforts we were named as successful participants.

honors.title: Honorable Mention - Moody's Mega Math Challenge
honors.description: Received in honorable mention as a part of a team working on the Math Modeling competition "Moody's Mega Math Challenge".
